title: Churn Configuration
description: User preferences for the Churn skill

defaultQuantity.description: Default number of items to generate when quantity is not specified

defaultMode.description: Default output mode when mode is not specified

terseFormat.description: Use terse format (3-10 words per item). If false, allows longer descriptions.

includeWildIdeas.description: Include impractical/wild ideas in output. Core to the no-filter philosophy.
